name: chess-style
description: Which grandmaster plays like you? Style matching for chess.com players, adjusted for rating and openings, with held-out validation.

paragraphs: You type in a chess.com username and pick Rapid or Blitz. The app reads that player's last 300 games, works out their habits (how they spend the clock, when they castle, whether they trade queens early, how often they sacrifice) and tells you which grandmasters share those habits. Then it lists that grandmaster's games in the openings you actually play, so you know what to study next.

The catch is that a 1800 player and a grandmaster are very different in strength, so a naive comparison just says "the GM is better". To get around that, every habit is measured against players of the same rating and adjusted for the opening played. What's left is style, not skill.

I wanted to know which grandmasters play the most like me, so I could learn from them by going through their games. Copying "the best player" isn't much help if their style has nothing to do with mine. A GM who makes the same kind of decisions I do, in the openings I play, is a much better teacher.
